items.evidence: Acceptance test passes. It checks every chip field is a safe integer, that chips are conserved after each step, that the hand reaches showdown, and that awards are above 0.9*MAX. A mutation that changes the check from > to >= makes it fail. Holdout: always-raise, call, bet and check policies, with stake units 2^44, 2^45 and the largest valid unit, on 3, 6 and 10 seats with stacks totalling exactly MAX, using several buttons and decks. A recursive scan of every number in every state, plus all offered legal action amounts, found only safe integers, and chips were always conserved.

fast-check property (100 runs) passes; reads per-step checks via the shared helper. Holdout property (200 runs) with uneven weighted stacks summing to exactly MAX, random stakes in valid A-4 range, random decks/buttons/actions: all numbers safe, conservation holds.

Acceptance test passes. It fails when the total check is removed or moved ahead of the per-seat check. Holdout: J-1-01 (10 x MAX at bigBet 112589990684261) throws a RangeError with the exact message. For 3, 4, 7 and 10 seats, a total of exactly MAX is accepted, and totals of MAX+1, MAX+2 and MAX+1000 are rejected. Two seats of ceil(MAX/2) and 10 x (MAX-1) are both rejected. The existing errors still take precedence: a below-minimum seat, a non-integer seat, a NaN seat and an Infinity seat each give their per-seat message, invalid stakes gives 'Invalid stakes', and 2 seats gives the seat-count message.

Acceptance test passes. Mutating the A-4 factor to 9 or to 11 makes it fail. Holdout: 10*minimumStack at bigBet 112589990684261 is 9007199254740960 and the hand is accepted; 112589990684262 gives 'Invalid stakes'.

Acceptance test passes. A mutation that reads config.button a second time makes it fail. Holdout: stack getters on 3 seats are read exactly 3 times. A getter that returns MAX on its first read and 160 afterwards is still rejected with the total error, so validation runs on the snapshot.
